This domain addresses the standardized processes required for effectively handling incoming alerts, executing rapid triage procedures, and managing related incidents to minimize service disruption and downtime across your organization.

This domain explores configuring complex on-call rosters, setting up schedules, and managing automated escalations to guarantee reliable support coverage and prompt response times across technical support teams operating within the platform.

This domain centers on proven methodologies for the ongoing improvement of ITOM services, tracking ongoing enhancements, and refining operational workflows to drive long-term business value and stability across your enterprise deployment.
